title: scale_prompt_for_model's MID tier (2B-7B) is unreachable from `apr code`: the only call site calls it only below 2B
evidence: quorum-PMAT-3719 lane 1 (claude-sonnet-5), confirmed by c1 2026-09-27 at a96772bd0: crates/aprender-orchestrate/src/agent/code.rs:565-570 runs `if params_b < 2.0 { system_prompt = scale_prompt_for_model(params_b) }`, so the 2-7B MID_SYSTEM_PROMPT and the 7B+ branch of code_prompts.rs:154 run only from unit tests. Pre-existing; #3719's 4B/9B cells get the full CODE_SYSTEM_PROMPT and pass.
ask: Either call scale_prompt_for_model for every size and let it pick the tier, or delete the MID branch and its table row. A falsifier drives cmd_code with a 4B-named model and asserts which prompt it sends.
